parallels.story_headline: Saudi oil exports plummet as Houthi control of Red Sea disrupts global shipping / Italy to deploy warships to protect shipping through Bab al-Mandeb strait
parallels.historical_event: Piracy off the coast of Somalia
parallels.summary: Somali piracy in the Gulf of Aden and off the Horn of Africa escalated from a threat to local fishing fleets into a menace against international shipping during 2006-2009, eventually costing global trade an estimated $6.6-6.9 billion a year and driving Gulf of Aden insurance premiums up tenfold from 2007 to 2008. It took a sustained multinational naval presence, not a single country's ships, to restore free passage.
parallels.parallel_analysis: Italy's solo deployment to Bab el-Mandeb echoes the earlier piracy era's opening moves, when individual navies acted before a coordinated international task force followed; a chokepoint this important to global energy markets needs more than one flag protecting it.

parallels.story_headline: Bank of Japan raises benchmark interest rate to 31-year high of 1.25%
parallels.summary: Paul Volcker's Federal Reserve pushed the federal funds rate from 11% in 1979 to a peak of 20% in June 1981 to confront double-digit US inflation, a deliberate break from years of loose monetary policy. Inflation fell from a peak of 14.8% in March 1980 to under 3% by 1983, but at the cost of the 1980-1982 recession and unemployment above 10%.
parallels.parallel_analysis: Japan's climb to a 31-year-high rate is far more gradual and the starting inflation problem much milder, but the underlying tension is the same one Volcker faced: global markets built on cheap money have to relearn how to price risk once a major central bank decides accommodation is over.

parallels.story_headline: Ukrainian President Zelenskiy Arrives in Dublin for EU Presidency Ceremony
parallels.historical_event: The Marshall Plan (1948-1952) and the Lend-Lease Act (1941)
parallels.summary: The Marshall Plan committed the United States to years of economic reconstruction aid for a Europe exhausted by war, and the earlier Lend-Lease Act extended matériel to allies before the US had formally entered the conflict. Both turned symbolic gestures of solidarity into durable multi-year commitments.
parallels.parallel_analysis: Ireland's EU presidency opening, with Zelenskiy on the stage, functions the same way for Ukraine now: a ceremonial moment intended to signal that European support is not going to lapse as the war grinds into its sixth year.
